name: Grace Athena Boland Bader
office: Wiseburn Unified School District, Governing Board Member

items.text: Grace Athena Boland Bader is a nurse. At a July 20, 2026, Wiseburn school board meeting, she criticized the board for limiting public comment at a prior meeting and alleged that board member Roger Banuelos used the platform to defend his corporate resume. She cited a district survey she said showed 23% of students are bullied for their race.
